info.name: AWS B2B Data Interchange Capabilities API

description.content: AWS B2B Data Interchange automates the transformation and exchange of electronic data interchange (EDI) documents at cloud scale. It enables businesses to onboard trading partners, transform X12 EDI documents to and from JSON or XML, and manage capabilities, profiles, partnerships, and transformers with pay-as-you-go pricing.
